elaine: Quick quarterly recurrence run - top signature is "stale-kv on scale-down" (≈10 hits in last 120d).
carl: yep, correlates tightly with aggressive scale-down events; we see short NPEs and downstream 504s.
ryan: i'll take consolidated postmortem + repro harness (PM-FIX-21).
pat: i'll own infra mitigation and AMI bake checks (INF-FIX-77).
ops-bot: Digest created: 'recurrence-retro-2301' -> https://redwood.internal/ops/digests/2301
elaine: quick hypotheses: 1) invalidation race during node tear-down, 2) autoscaler thins warm pool too fast, 3) boot/init ordering change after recent AMI.
ryan: timeline proposal: draft postmortem by 2026-04-09, repro harness + minimal test fixture by 2026-04-12.
pat: infra prototype + AMI verification by 2026-04-08, target canary flip 2026-04-13.
carl: monitoring action: i'll add dashboard tiles kv_stale_rate, kv_invalidation_latency and alert if stale_rate > 3% sustained 10m (ticket MON-118).
ryan: SQL i ran to group signatures (slightly different shape):
```sql
SELECT signature, COUNT(*) AS hits, array_agg(id) AS incident_ids
FROM incidents
WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '120 days'
GROUP BY signature
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY hits DESC;
```
pat: infra mitigation sketch: add pre-warm hook in init that primes cache and acquires an invalidation lock for safe teardown; also add safer invalidation ordering to avoid NPE windows. i'll post patch in INF-FIX-77.
elaine: please tag all related tickets with recurrence=kvchurn-stale so the recurrence scanner groups them automatically.
ops-bot: Follow-up scheduled: 2026-04-14 10:00 PT.
carl: canary gate: abort if p95 > 1.3x baseline for 5m OR if kv_stale_rate > 2% sustained 5m. i'll wire the gate.
ryan: postmortem PR will include: repro steps, fixture to simulate scale-down, baseline histograms for tail latency, and rollback plan.
pat: i'll coordinate a maintenance window for the canary and attach AMI bake logs to INF-FIX-77.
elaine: owners recap: Ryan -> PM-FIX-21 (postmortem + repro), Pat -> INF-FIX-77 (infra + bake), Carl -> MON-118 (monitoring + synthetic), Elaine -> COMM-5 (internal FAQ & support prep).
carl: i'll add the synthetic that toggles scale-downs and capture kv miss/latency graphs, linking to MON-118.
ryan: tiny ask: include correlation id kvchurn-stale-2301 in PRs/tickets so the recurrence dashboards link artifacts.
pat: noted. i'll add that tag to INF-FIX-77 and the canary PR.
elaine: final: use the ticket threads for incremental updates; reopen this thread if we need synthesis or blockers. :thumbsup:
